source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 14ης Αυγούστου — «Άγιος Λούκιος ο στρατιώτης»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 14 Αυγούστου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The whole notice is one sentence — «Ο Άγιος Λούκιος ο στρατιώτης μαρτύρησε δια πυρός», Saint Lucius the soldier was martyred by fire — above the couplet «Φυγών παλαιάν Λούκιε ζύμην πλάνης, / Kαυθείς επώφθης ένζυμον Θεώ νέον». There is no country, no century, no emperor, no year and no hymn, and the `soldier` type is the line's own «ο στρατιώτης». **The corpus keeps a Lucius whose `greek` row is already venerated on 23 Μαΐου, slug `lucius-of-africa`, martyred in Africa in 430 by the Arians with Quintianus and Julian; that is another day and another manner of death, and by the settled rule two entries on one calendar are two commemorations, so this is a second man.** No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page. The page prints no apolytikion and no kontakion, so this folder takes no hymn.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (1 October 2026).
